title: Kraus's 1884 Conjecture and the Gap in His Proof
statement: Ludwig Kraus's 1884 paper states, as its main result, the modern plane Jacobian conjecture rather than merely an earlier adjacent problem.

members.title: Kraus stated the plane conjecture in 1884
members.statement: Ludwig Kraus's 1884 paper states, as its main result, the modern plane Jacobian conjecture rather than merely an earlier adjacent problem.

members.title: The gap in Kraus's proposed proof
members.statement: The final step of Kraus's claimed proof is invalid because the chosen parametrization does not justify the required derivative conclusion at infinity; the unresolved issue is control of ramification at infinity.
